entries.12c1e8c8535496e4: This business is conducted by a group consisting of the company, 14 consolidated subsidiaries and one affiliate, and its main business is the development, manufacture and sale of electronic musical instruments. It comprehensively offers a range of product lines including electronic pianos, drums, synthesizers and guitar-related equipment, and is also engaged in integrating "sound" and "video." 91% of the group's revenue (fiscal year ended December 2025) is derived from outside Japan. The head office is located in Shin-Tamada, Hamana-ku, Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture, and consolidated employees numbered 2,897 (as of December 31, 2025).

entries.4ba49cf7c70aa0c6: Since its founding in 1972, it has conducted research and development in step with advances in electronics technology and established a global brand in electronic musical instruments by producing many world-first technologies and products. It offers a well-balanced range of product lines, including electronic pianos, drums, synthesizers and guitar-related equipment, and has established overseas sales companies since its early days to deploy its products globally.
entries.4bf03d0aa41b37af: This product group includes electronic drums, acoustic drums and electronic wind instruments. Drum Workshop, Inc. in the United States is responsible for development, manufacture and sales of acoustic drums. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥29,364 million, the largest among product categories.
entries.58184adacb7f3f0e: An electronic musical instrument manufacturer that develops and manufactures a wide range of electronic instruments, such as digital pianos, electronic drums and synthesizers, and sells them around the world.
entries.628ffbd5bc67a93e: This product group includes guitar effects and instrument amplifiers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥25,149 million.
entries.6f75bc584b4e068e: The company has formulated a medium-term management plan covering the three years from January 2026. As the future it aims to realize, the company has set the goal of “creating new music lifestyles and music culture together with next-generation users and opening up the future of music,” and its priority strategies are “Direct Connect,” which strengthens direct and continuous contact with customers; “Innovation,” which promotes the electronification of acoustic instruments and joint development; and expanding sales in emerging countries.
